remarks: ***HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS REQUESTED BY MONDAY, 1/6, AT 5 PM*** Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, Bishop Meadows provides a tranquil retreat with a perfect blend of space, privacy, and convenience. This rare stand-alone, 3-floor townhouse is the largest unit in the entire complex, offering the privacy of a single-family home with the added benefit of being part of a beautifully maintained community full of amenities - such as the private community pool and clubhouse with sauna right across from the unit! There is plenty of room to live and entertain, with a spacious main floor living room with cozy wood burning fireplace, dining room area and balcony style deck. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances complete with dishwasher. The lower level features another big family room great for entertaining, media room or playroom, with sliders leading to the outdoor patio perfect for enjoying the fresh air. A laundry room with washer/dryer adds to the convenience. Upstairs are three large bedrooms and full bathroom with shower-tub. The primary bedroom features multiple closets, including a large walk-in that is large enough to be used as an office. Bishop Meadows' location is an opportunity for any lifestyle. Just steps from the entrance, you'll find the beach, parks, and a boating marina, making it easy to enjoy the relaxing outdoors.
